protocol.purpose: User-authorized factorial pilot: fixed student anchor and proposal-aligned execution-aware counterfactual credit
protocol.initialization: All four arms exactly copy the same paired Step2 actor and train-only standardizer; matched fresh critic/optimizer and RL seeds. No scratch arm; plain is a fresh-noise replication of unanchored ordinary fine-tuning. Same100k RL transitions per job, unequal optimization compute due anchor/counterfactual overhead disclosed.

anchor.loss: KL(frozen student || current actor), half current rollout minibatch and half equal-size random existing Step2 TRAIN-observation replay. No labels or DEV/test rows used. Student fixed, no gradients; mean over2B rows. Independent persistent replay RNG seed=RLseed+90000000. No coefficient tuning or adaptation. Anchor is optimization-only, absent at actor inference.

credit.reward: At an available inference request, clone current plant/observer/worker/gate twice. Submit current proposal once versus a zero proposal; all subsequent proposals zero in both branches. Forecast future sensor innovations as zero, retaining measurement/process covariance and current delayed raw observation. Run actual nonlinear plant and frozen observer/worker/gate for20ticks. Cost=sum lateral_error_squared with2.5m failed-tail penalty. Reward=clip((Jzero-Jproposal)/max(Jzero,1e-4),-1,1) minus10 if actual transition fails. Zero reward for in-flight ignored actions, zero proposal, and command-identical branches. No common tracking/survival-positive/effort bonus and no old relative bonus in credit arms.
credit.gradient: Exclude in-flight ignored actions from PPO actor/entropy loss and normalize advantages over eligible actions only; critic uses every tick. Availability from pre-action observed pending flag/channel17 and remaining-time/channel15, tested against worker. Student anchor, when enabled, uses all observed rows.
credit.limits: This is privileged training-only MODEL-PREDICTED single-request credit, not observed future outcome or unbiased expected reward. Current true state/parameters only reward-side; no actual future-noise draws; no hidden actor inputs. Zero-innovation forecast can be biased, so closed-loop improvement must be measured. Counterfactual planning does not alter actual physical execution.

protocol.training: Same uniformly sampled revision6 speeds/paths/six scenarios, initial ey.15m/heading.01rad, full ceil((220/speed+2)/.01) horizon and failure thresholds. Original20 sensor/history inputs, residual grid, gate, baseline, observer and plant unchanged. Reward-only VecNormalize continues across chunks. Plain/anchor retain original reward; credit/combined use new reward/masking. No new teacher labels.
protocol.training_noise: 920000000+pair_index*1000000+slot*10000+episode_index, disjoint from all prior campaigns. Same paired seeds/initial scenario streams; different failures can change streams.
protocol.checkpointing: All0/25k/50k/100k checkpoints, same model/optimizer/env over25k+25k+50k learn chunks, no normalizer reset, constant LR. Twelve jobs=1200000 additional RL transitions; no outcome-based extension.
protocol.noise_formula: base+pair_index*10000+speed*100+path_index*10+region_index; shared across methods, disjoint splits. Known task families only, not unseen-domain generalization.
protocol.development: 2052 episodes:3pairs*36conditions*(LQR,fixed-.04,student+four checkpoints for each of four arms). Select per arm/pair lowest mean penalized RMSE among eligible; ties earlier step. Eligibility: no regional survival loss vs student,LQR,fixed; nominal<=1.02student and every other active region<=1.01student; latency100 exact LQR fallback. If none eligible, explicitly unqualified best available, no success claim. Every arm0 must exactly reproduce student. Publish selection before test.
protocol.evaluation: 1188 episodes:3pairs*36conditions*(LQR,fixed-.04,student+four selected arms+four100k endpoints). All selections fixed before fresh-noise test; no choice of new arm/checkpoint on test. Primary mean penalized episode RMSE, failed tails2.5m.
protocol.success_rule: Each arm assessed separately: selected arm at least1% lower RMSE than frozen student, all3seed means lower, all selections eligible, no regional survival loss vs student/LQR/fixed; nominal<=1.02student, other active regions<=1.01student; at least1% better than LQR AND fixed. Report all arms including failure; no best-arm global superiority inference. Initialization0 retention is not gain. Anchor/credit/interaction attribution only descriptive factorial paired differences on endpoints; no significance claim from3pairs.
protocol.stop: Stop after12x100k jobs, frozen dev/test and verification. No retries, coefficient/reward tuning, extra teacher data, geometry/gate edits, deployment promotion, native campaign or new MPC superiority claim. Preserve previous results.
